description: This file defines the EmployeeTimeReportController class in the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller and sets up a Vue component for employee time reports during the pre-rendering phase.

classes.name: EmployeeTimeReportController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling employee time report view, extending the abstract Vue controller.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the controller's output before rendering by setting up the Vue component for employee time report.
